parameters.query: WITH config_values AS ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS values FROM settings WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY['SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_DAYS','SNAPSHOT_RECENT_MAX_AGE_HOURS','SNAPSHOT_INTERMEDIATE_MAX_AGE_HOURS','SNAPSHOT_RECENT_INTERVAL_MINUTES','SNAPSHOT_INTERMEDIATE_INTERVAL_MINUTES','SNAPSHOT_OLDER_INTERVAL_MINUTES','SNAPSHOT_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN','YOUTUBE_QUOTA_BUDGET_PER_RUN','YOUTUBE_VIDEOS_LIST_QUOTA_COST']) ), configured AS ( SELECT values, (values ->> 'SNAPSHOT_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN')::integer AS max_videos_per_run, (values ->> 'YOUTUBE_QUOTA_BUDGET_PER_RUN')::integer AS quota_budget, (values ->> 'YOUTUBE_VIDEOS_LIST_QUOTA_COST')::integer AS videos_list_quota_cost FROM config_values ), started_run AS ( INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow, status, metadata) SELECT '02 - TrendLens - Video Snapshot Tracker', 'running', jsonb_build_object('active_days', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_DAYS', 'recent_max_age_hours', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_RECENT_MAX_AGE_HOURS', 'intermediate_max_age_hours', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_INTERMEDIATE_MAX_AGE_HOURS', 'recent_interval_minutes', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_RECENT_INTERVAL_MINUTES', 'intermediate_interval_minutes', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_INTERMEDIATE_INTERVAL_MINUTES', 'older_interval_minutes', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_OLDER_INTERVAL_MINUTES', 'max_videos_per_run', values -> 'SNAPSHOT_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN', 'batch_size', 50) FROM configured RETURNING id, started_at ), selected AS ( SELECT candidate.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY candidate.last_collected_at, candidate.published_at, candidate.video_id) AS candidate_order FROM started_run CROSS JOIN configured CROSS JOIN LATERAL select_snapshot_candidates(started_run.started_at, LEAST(configured.max_videos_per_run, GREATEST((configured.quota_budget / GREATEST(configured.videos_list_quota_cost, 1)) * 50, 0))) candidate ), batches AS ( SELECT (((candidate_order - 1) / 50) + 1)::integer AS batch_number, string_agg(external_id, ',' ORDER BY candidate_order) AS external_ids, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('video_id', video_id, 'external_id', external_id) ORDER BY candidate_order) AS candidates, count(*)::integer AS candidate_count FROM selected GROUP BY ((candidate_order - 1) / 50) ) SELECT started_run.id AS pipeline_run_id, started_run.started_at AS run_started_at, configured.videos_list_quota_cost AS youtube_videos_list_quota_cost, batches.batch_number, batches.external_ids, COALESCE(batches.candidates, '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates, COALESCE(batches.candidate_count, 0) AS candidate_count FROM started_run CROSS JOIN configured LEFT JOIN batches ON TRUE ORDER BY batches.batch_number;

WITH arguments AS ( SELECT $1::bigint AS pipeline_run_id, (SELECT started_at FROM pipeline_runs WHERE id = $1::bigint) AS collected_at, $2::integer AS batch_number, COALESCE($3::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates, COALESCE($4::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb) AS response_items, $5::integer AS quota_cost ), expected AS ( SELECT item.video_id, item.external_id FROM arguments CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(arguments.candidates) AS item(video_id bigint, external_id text) ), returned AS ( SELECT element ->> 'id' AS external_id, NULLIF(element #>> '{statistics,viewCount}', '')::bigint AS views, NULLIF(element #>> '{statistics,likeCount}', '')::bigint AS likes, NULLIF(element #>> '{statistics,commentCount}', '')::bigint AS comments FROM arguments CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(arguments.response_items) AS element ), matched AS ( SELECT expected.video_id, expected.external_id, returned.external_id AS returned_external_id, returned.views, returned.likes, returned.comments FROM expected LEFT JOIN returned USING (external_id) ), snapshot_insert AS ( INSERT INTO video_snapshots (video_id, collected_at, views, likes, comments) SELECT matched.video_id, arguments.collected_at, matched.views, matched.likes, matched.comments FROM matched CROSS JOIN arguments WHERE matched.returned_external_id IS NOT NULL AND matched.views IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (video_id, collected_at) DO NOTHING RETURNING video_id ), counts AS ( SELECT (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM expected) AS expected_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM matched WHERE returned_external_id IS NULL) AS missing_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM matched WHERE returned_external_id IS NOT NULL AND views IS NULL) AS invalid_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM snapshot_insert) AS inserted_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM matched WHERE returned_external_id IS NOT NULL AND views IS NOT NULL) - (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM snapshot_insert) AS duplicate_count, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(external_id ORDER BY external_id) FROM matched WHERE returned_external_id IS NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS missing_external_ids, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(external_id ORDER BY external_id) FROM matched WHERE returned_external_id IS NOT NULL AND views IS NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS invalid_external_ids ), error_insert AS ( INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (pipeline_run_id, workflow, node, error_type, error_message, retry_count, metadata) SELECT arguments.pipeline_run_id, '02 - TrendLens - Video Snapshot Tracker', 'Persistir snapshots do lote', 'youtube_snapshot_items_incomplete', 'YouTube did not return usable public statistics for every requested video', 0, jsonb_build_object('batch_number', arguments.batch_number, 'missing_external_ids', counts.missing_external_ids, 'invalid_external_ids', counts.invalid_external_ids) FROM arguments CROSS JOIN counts WHERE counts.missing_count + counts.invalid_count > 0 RETURNING id ), run_update AS ( UPDATE pipeline_runs SET items_received = items_received + counts.expected_count, items_processed = items_processed + counts.inserted_count, items_skipped = items_skipped + counts.duplicate_count, items_failed = items_failed + counts.missing_count + counts.invalid_count, api_calls = api_calls + 1, quota_units_estimated = quota_units_estimated + arguments.quota_cost, metadata = jsonb_set(metadata, '{videos_list_calls}', to_jsonb(COALESCE((metadata ->> 'videos_list_calls')::integer, 0) + 1), true) FROM arguments CROSS JOIN counts WHERE pipeline_runs.id = arguments.pipeline_run_id RETURNING pipeline_runs.id, pipeline_runs.status, pipeline_runs.items_received, pipeline_runs.items_processed, pipeline_runs.items_skipped, pipeline_runs.items_failed, pipeline_runs.api_calls, pipeline_runs.quota_units_estimated ) SELECT run_update.*, arguments.batch_number, counts.expected_count, counts.inserted_count, counts.duplicate_count, counts.missing_count, counts.invalid_count, (SELECT id FROM error_insert) AS pipeline_error_id FROM run_update CROSS JOIN arguments CROSS JOIN counts;

WITH arguments AS ( SELECT $1::bigint AS pipeline_run_id, $2::integer AS batch_number, COALESCE($3::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb) AS candidates, $4::text AS error_message, $5::integer AS quota_cost ), error_insert AS ( INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (pipeline_run_id, workflow, node, error_type, error_message, retry_count, metadata) SELECT arguments.pipeline_run_id, '02 - TrendLens - Video Snapshot Tracker', 'Atualizar métricas no YouTube', 'youtube_snapshot_request_error', left(regexp_replace(arguments.error_message, '(?i)(access_token|authorization|api[_-]?key|token)[^ ,;]*', '[REDACTED]', 'g'), 4000), 2, jsonb_build_object('batch_number', arguments.batch_number, 'candidates', arguments.candidates) FROM arguments RETURNING id ), run_update AS ( UPDATE pipeline_runs SET items_received = items_received + jsonb_array_length(arguments.candidates), items_failed = items_failed + jsonb_array_length(arguments.candidates), api_calls = api_calls + 1, quota_units_estimated = quota_units_estimated + arguments.quota_cost, metadata = jsonb_set(metadata, '{videos_list_calls}', to_jsonb(COALESCE((metadata ->> 'videos_list_calls')::integer, 0) + 1), true) FROM arguments WHERE pipeline_runs.id = arguments.pipeline_run_id RETURNING pipeline_runs.id, pipeline_runs.status, pipeline_runs.items_received, pipeline_runs.items_processed, pipeline_runs.items_failed, pipeline_runs.api_calls, pipeline_runs.quota_units_estimated ) SELECT run_update.*, arguments.batch_number, (SELECT id FROM error_insert) AS pipeline_error_id FROM run_update CROSS JOIN arguments;

parameters.query: WITH updated AS ( UPDATE pipeline_runs SET finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), status = CASE WHEN items_failed > 0 AND items_processed = 0 THEN 'failed' WHEN items_failed > 0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'success' END, duration_seconds = COALESCE(duration_seconds, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - started_at))), metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('candidates_selected', items_received, 'snapshots_collected', items_processed, 'duplicate_snapshots', items_skipped, 'videos_list_calls', api_calls) WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING * ) SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id, workflow, status, items_received, items_processed, items_skipped, items_failed, api_calls, quota_units_estimated, duration_seconds, metadata, started_at, finished_at FROM updated;
